name: Flow Buddy
description:
Learn Vim's faster commands while you work. Flow Buddy notices habits like pressing j seven times to reach a blank line, and shows the shorter way (}) in a card under the top bar. Its menu has your recent tips, the coaching mode and the settings.

This extension is Flow Buddy's desktop part: it needs the Flow Buddy daemon, installed from https://github.com/AbdelrahmanWM/Flow-Buddy (see docs/install.md). Until then, the menu says how to start it.

Keys are turned into counts and habits on your machine. Nothing you type is kept, and nothing is sent anywhere.
